name: Land Portal linked open-data catalog

operator.name: Land Portal Foundation
operator.evidence: Official terms identify the Foundation and Netherlands address; footer RSIN854330045. No independent registration lookup.

capabilities: Public SPARQL dataset-label/native-URI queries over the documented dataset graph.
Published country/indicator aggregate model and Land Library metadata model; actual aggregate values/full content not yet verified.
limitations: Dataset labels do not prove downloadable values, current civic records, complete land-rights content or country coverage.
Personal owners, survey respondents and parcel-party data excluded.
Metadata and content licenses differ; library resource full text is not automatically open.

cases.intent: Verify a previously observed native dataset URI and label only. Dataset labels do not verify country values, personal ownership, legal title, full documents or independent origins.

params.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?dataset ?label FROM <http://datasets.landportal.info> WHERE { ?dataset <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?label . FILTER (lang(?label) = "" || langMatches(lang(?label), "en")) VALUES ?dataset { <http://data.landportal.info/dataset/AFRB-SURV> } } ORDER BY STR(?dataset) LIMIT 2 OFFSET 0

query.authentication: Anonymous public endpoint; no key/account/payment used.
query.cost: Public metadata queries at no charge in this sample; no numeric quota or unlimited use promise.
query.paging: ORDER BY STR(?dataset),LIMIT2,OFFSET; explicit child-observation exclusion.
supported_modes: Exact native dataset URI and English/unlabelled label lookup
unsupported_modes: SPARQL writes,SERVICE,federated queries or unrestricted graphs
Actual country indicator values or full document reading not yet tested

licensing: Published LOD license is Open Data Commons Attribution; website generally CC BY4.0 with per-item restrictions. Land Library openness generally covers metadata only, not actual resources.
next_action: Complete dataset publisher/license/version and actual non-personal aggregate value retrieval, then country/indicator/relevance/reader/error/refresh checks. Do not treat dataset labels or tenure-security perceptions as ownership registers or P04 civic closure. Reuse documented Land Library model only for permitted metadata; content is not automatically open.

identity_and_duplicates.summary: Land Portal Foundation runs one aggregation/knowledge catalog; the query interface and underlying datasets are not independent origins.

operator.name: Land Portal Foundation
operator.evidence: Official terms identify the Foundation and Netherlands address; footer RSIN854330045. No independent registration lookup.

facts.deduplication: Afrobarometer,FAO,IFPRI and Prindex attribution must be preserved separately. Ten dataset IDs are not ten sources. A shared Virtuoso connector,translated labels and individual statistical observations do not create origins.
facts.native_namespace: Current returned dataset URIs use http://data.landportal.info/dataset/. Published model examples use data.landportal.org; preserve actual returned identity rather than silently rewriting it.

open_questions: Confirm publisher attribution and version/identity mapping per retained dataset.

coverage_and_languages.summary: Current queries cover dataset labels only; topical/jurisdiction membership remains partial.

facts.query_area: C19 only. P04/P08 candidate tags have empty case mappings until actual civic/aggregate evidence exists.
facts.languages: English or untagged label literals observed. Site has multiple UI languages, not proof all resources are translated.
facts.country: No USA/India country values or independent network vantage tested.
facts.Prindex_scope: 2019/2020 catalog page describes survey-based perceived tenure security across140/141 countries; it is not a legal title or ownership register.

open_questions: Verify actual aggregate datasets,country/language coverage and legal/civic relevance without owner or respondent data.

query_contract.summary: Official developer page publishes the SPARQL endpoint and graphs; live form exposes JSON and an execution-timeout field.

params.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?dataset ?label FROM <http://datasets.landportal.info> WHERE { ?dataset <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?label . FILTER (lang(?label) = "" || langMatches(lang(?label), "en")) VALUES ?dataset { <http://data.landportal.info/dataset/AFRB-SURV> } } ORDER BY STR(?dataset) LIMIT 2 OFFSET 0

facts.response_shape: SPARQL results JSON head.vars dataset,label; bindings typed uri/literal. Metadata labels only.
facts.namespace_guard: Fixed datasets graph,native dataset URI prefix and no child path; reject catalog root,duplicate IDs,wrong binding types/languages and oversized results.
facts.paging: Five bounded pages; initial page8 returned an aggregate observation URI inside datasets graph. It failed semantic validation; narrower documented SELECT filters child paths and returns dataset labels. Original result retained.
facts.empty: Missing native dataset ID returnedHTTP200 empty bindings.
facts.schema_caution: Graph name is not a sufficient semantic type guarantee; no country observation is accepted as a dataset.

rights_and_cost.summary: Official licensing separates website content,linked data and software rights.

facts.linked_data: Open Data Commons Attribution License for the published triplestore; preserve attribution and inspect upstream dataset restrictions.
facts.website: Generally CC BY4.0; specific restrictions may apply and user-posted material may be changed or inaccurate.
facts.library: Official license page explicitly says Land Library generally opens metadata,not the actual resource.
facts.software: MIT License for software is separate from data/content licensing.
facts.cost_authentication: No key,login,payment or account used for bounded queries. User registration/posting functions not used.
facts.metadata_integrity: Provider may change,remove or limit content without notice; not a legal-title certification.

open_questions: Reconcile upstream publisher rights and native dataset/license/version for retained data; do not apply site footer license to all linked works.

reader_access.summary: Public developer,terms,data and Prindex explanatory pages captured; no complete statistical data or library work was read.

facts.Prindex: Only explanatory page read; survey microdata and questionnaire responses not requested.
facts.registration: Login controls exist but sampled public pages/query endpoint worked anonymously.

open_questions: Verify actual permitted aggregate output or complete library reader,version,accessibility and country conditions.

quality_and_relevance.summary: Dataset metadata is queryable,but catalog/schema inconsistencies must not inflate evidence.

facts.scope: Ten native dataset expectations derive from earlier small-page observations; query results are not land-rights factual assertions.
facts.negative: Initial dataset graph search included catalog root and a child aggregate observation. Parser refuses both; refined prefix/child filter is saved.
facts.no_false_gap_closure: P04 remains without verified civic-record queries; Prindex perceptions are distinct from ownership or current title.

open_questions: Review topic relevance,metadata errors,representative aggregate values and current country/year scope.

operating_limits.summary: Serial4-second pauses,128KiB responses,5-second provider query timeout and exclusive collector lock.

facts.quota: No numeric provider quota found; no throughput extrapolation.
facts.allowed_scope: Fixed read-only SELECT over dataset metadata only; no updates,external SERVICE,people or observations graphs.
facts.error_behavior: Semantic rejection and successful empty observed. Real quota/error response and refresh/removal contract not yet established; no rate limit deliberately triggered.
facts.policy: Current robots200 permits sampled documented endpoint. About301 followed only to published who-we-are.

open_questions: Establish later-session reliability,provider error/timeout behavior and bounded revision/deletion refresh.

decision_and_followup.summary: Retain a research-only metadata catalog candidate; full qualification and all target closures remain open.
